newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo corn futures close higher.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo corn futures close higher.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Thursday, as the yen's weaker tone against the dollar and price gains in the soybean market encouraged buying by local investors, traders said.
Prices were 10 to 90 yen higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract up 30 yen at 15,890 yen per tonne.

All contracts were weaker in early trading, but investors gradually stepped in to buy in line with soybean's gains, traders said. "The yen's weaker sentiment also encouraged them to buy," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was trading at $2.98-1/2 per bushel at 0658 GMT, unchanged from Wednesday's close.
The spot May CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system were at $8.43-1/4 at 0658 GMT, up from $8.42-1/2 at Wednesday's close.
